g.text: swap_router and fee_bps fixed at creation
a mock Jupiter, fixed at strategy creation

svg.text: NVDAx rises $180 → $200. The fund is now worth $960 and each share about
$1.07 — nothing had to happen for that to be true, because the share price is
NAV divided by supply, recomputed from the feeds every time it matters.
but the weights drifted to 37.5 / 62.5 against the 40 / 60 target, and that is
Maria’s actual job: sell the over-weighted asset, buy the under-weighted one,
both legs through the fixed router, both floored at the oracle price less 1%.
Maria signs rebalance(); no token passes anywhere near her.
What a careless manager can still do is churn — pointless
rebalancing that pays market slippage. That hurts depositors
without enriching her, the design’s honest boundary.
